narrative.overview: The category standard played straight. A white page, pale-blue tint bands, one drenched sky-blue band, and the organisation's own photographs shown large. Headlines in Bricolage Grotesque say what the NGO does; Figtree carries the reading. Light only, bilingual, calm and generous density. Sky blue marks action and is never spread as ornament.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, sky-tint bands, one sky band; ink text throughout.
Pill-shaped controls, rounded (18px) photo and card corners.
Real photos first; tint is the placeholder behind them.
Self-hosted variable fonts (Fontsource), fluid type scale.
Soft single shadow, used for response to state and for the hero photos only.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Sky Rule
rules.body: Text on a #0ea5e9 fill is ink (#0f172a). White on sky fails contrast.

rules.name: The Small-Text Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue text below large size is #0369a1 (or #075985 on tint). Never #0ea5e9 or #0284c7. #0369a1 is derived because #0ea5e9 and #0284c7 fail AA for small text on white.

rules.name: The One Band Rule
rules.body: One full-bleed sky band per page at most; tint bands carry the rest of the rhythm.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Bricolage for headings, nav on mobile, and large contact lines; Figtree for everything else.

rules.name: The Response-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Outside the hero photo trio, shadow appears only as a response to hover or focus, or on a floating panel.

dos: Do put ink text on sky (#0ea5e9) fills and #0369a1 / #075985 for small blue text.
Do let real photos lead, on tint placeholders, at 18px corners.
Do keep controls pill-shaped with a 44px minimum touch height.
Do use the 3px #0284c7 focus ring everywhere.
Do keep copy-and-photo sections alternating between white and tint, with at most one sky band.
donts: Don't use #0ea5e9 or #0284c7 as text colour on white.
Don't add decorative icon-card trios, gradient heroes, or ornamental stock imagery.
Don't add shadows at rest to cards or buttons.
Don't introduce a second display face or a dark theme; the site is light only.
Don't use hard-edged corners on controls or cards.
